newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: SOCCER-AJAX CRUSH 10-MAN RANGERS IN CHAMPIONS LEAGUE.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-AJAX CRUSH 10-MAN RANGERS IN CHAMPIONS LEAGUE.

text.p: Two first half goals from Ajax's teenage Portuguese striker Dani helped the Dutch side celebrate their 100th European Cup match in style on Wednesday, crushing Glasgow Rangers 4-1.
The first of Dani's goals, both headers, came in the 25th minute from a floated cross from Tijani Babangida on the right.
The Nigerian international found Dani on the edge of the penalty area rising above the Rangers defence to fire a powerful header past the outstretched right hand of reserve goalkeeper Theo Snelders.

An Ajax side, already gaining the upper hand, were given an extra boost in the 29th minute, when Paul Gasgoigne was sent off for kicking out at Ajax's Winston Bogarde after coming off second best in a tussle with keeper Edwin van der Saar.

Now playing with ten men the gaps in the Rangers defence seemed to open up even more readily and in the 41st minute Marc Overmars ghosted down the leftand whipped in a cross into the path of an advancing Dani, who headed past Snelders for his second.
Rangers had to soak up more pressure in the second half but the home side did not score again until the 83rd minute when Babangida found himself in front of an open goal to make it 3-0.
Rangers came back in the dying minutes getting a consolation goal in the 88th minute through Ian Durrant, who had come on minutes earlier as a substitute for Ferguson.
But then in the last minute Wooter, who came on for Dani in the 78th minute, made it four for Ajax to leave Rangers dead and buried.
